page_title: MAI 2-1 HEI | Mainz v Heidenheim 13/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Silvan Widmer (Mainz). That's a clear yellow card. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) goes into the book.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Urs Fischer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arnaud Nordin (Mainz) replacing Phillip Tietz.
90' Substitution. Nadiem Amiri makes his way off the pitch and Lennard Maloney (Mainz) comes on as his replacement.
88' Frank Schmidt (Heidenheim) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
87' Mainz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

87' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Mainz are awarded a corner kick.
85' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) gets into a promising shooting position on the edge of the box after a nice pass, but his effort is deflected onto the post by one of the defenders.
85' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
85' A snap shot from distance by Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
81' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Yannik Wagner (Heidenheim) replaces Jonas Fohrenbach.

81' What a great chance for Stefan Bell (Mainz). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
81' The ball goes out of play and Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Paul Nebel (Mainz) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Mainz force their opponents to concede a corner.

79' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar! The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
77' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
75' The attendance for today's match is 24500.
75' Here's the change. Julian Niehues leaves the pitch and Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) comes on as a substitute.
75' Heidenheim are ruled offside.
74' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
73' Sven Jablonski interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim). Mainz have a free kick.

71' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.

69' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Sven Jablonski blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Mainz earn a free kick.
69' Neat passing move from Heidenheim in order to create new attacking opportunities.

67' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
66' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Paul Nebel (Mainz). Sven Jablonski saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Heidenheim are awarded a free kick.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.

61' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Heidenheim will take a corner kick.
60' 2 - 1 Goal! Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 2:1.
60' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the right post is smartly dealt with by Daniel Batz.
59' Substitution. Armindo Sieb will be replaced by Paul Nebel (Mainz).
59' That will be all from Marvin Pieringer who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
59' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen and he is replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
54' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
52' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target.
52' Mainz take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

52' Great save! Armindo Sieb (Mainz) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Diant Ramaj. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.

49' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
49' 2 - 0 Goal! Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper inside the left post. 2:0.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Frank Schmidt probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim). He is replaced by Sirlord Conteh.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' It's a yellow card for Dominik Kohr (Mainz).

40' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) was too forceful with his tackle and Sven Jablonski interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Heidenheim, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

39' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.

37' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Phillip Tietz (Mainz), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
34' Nikolas Veratschnig is substituted due to injury. Urs Fischer gives a chance to Kacper Potulski (Mainz).
33' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' 1 - 0 What a goal! Jae-Sung Lee plays it to Silvan Widmer (Mainz), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Diant Ramaj into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
28' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.
28' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle after Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Heidenheim will take a free kick.

26' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Daniel Batz shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
25' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
25' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
21' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
20' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
18' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
16' Heidenheim seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

11' What a chance! The ball is inside the box and Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) takes a first-time shot on goal, but his volley goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
10' Heidenheim are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
9' Mainz quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

8' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the top left corner is blocked by Diant Ramaj, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Stefan Bell (Mainz) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Heidenheim will take a free kick near the side line.
1' The free kick from long range, taken by Heidenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Sven Jablonski couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) and blew his whistle. Heidenheim are awarded the free kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Sven Jablonski.
